title: big-number
description: One large figure with an optional label and 95% interval. A change of `value` counts up when the step animates. Bind `value` to a data file so no figure is typed by hand.

value.description: The figure: a number, usually one data binding with no format, e.g. {{data/summary.json#/responders}} (a binding with a format gives text, which is an error here; put the format in `format`).

format.description: d3-format specifier for the figure and the interval, localized by the deck language (decimal comma in `es`).

ci.description: 95% interval [lo, hi], shown as "95% CI lo–hi" ("IC 95%" in es) with the same format as the figure. May be one data binding that resolves to an array.

prefix.description: Text before the figure, such as a currency sign. Not applied to the interval.

suffix.description: Text after the figure, such as a unit. Not applied to the interval.
